newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T shares firm on demerger speculation.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T shares firm on demerger speculation.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc firmed in a mostly lower UK equity market on Monday after weekend press reports that the company was considering the demerger of its tobacco and insurance arms, dealers said.
The stock was up 1/2p at 560 by 0809 GMT in volume of just over a quarter of a million shares, even as the FTSE 100 index of blue chip stocks traded down 10.9 points at 4,683.0

Reports in the Guardian and the Daily Mail newspapers on Saturday said B.A.T had revived demerger plans to boost the group's value, five months after a plan to merge its insurance operations with Commercial Union Plc fell apart.

A spokesman for B.A.T said there was nothing to add to comments from chaiman Lord Cairns at B.A.T's recent annual shareholders' meeting, that there were "no sacred cows" and that a corporate restructuring would be considered if and when it was believed it would improve the company's prospects and boost shareholder value.
